html: II. אבל (perhaps أَبَلَ grow green, cf. ܝܺܒܶܠ grass; LagBN 45 proposes أَبَلَ withstand, hence אָבֵל as withstanding scorching sun (protected by trees, springs, hence also (Lag) إِبِلٌ camel). conject. very dub.; connex. (Lag) of أَبَلَ withstand, with أُبُلٌ herbage, forage (sometimes dry) improb., and of latter with إِبِلٌ herd of camels obscure; √ meaning grow green unattested; Syriac ܝܺܒܶܠ, ܝܰܒܠܴܐ, ܝܰܒܠܴܐ, Talm יַבְלָא, Pun. ιεβαλ, ‘grass,’ appar. = a specific kind of fodder, ἄγρωστις, v. LöwNö 141 (GFM, privately).)
